name: 🔥 Buffalo Chicken Wraps
what: Buffalo chicken rolled in tortillas with lettuce, cheese and ranch, toasted crisp.

core.name: Frank's RedHot
core.out: any hot sauce, or skip it for plain chicken wraps

core.name: Big flour tortillas
core.out: any tortillas, or serve it as a bowl over lettuce

extras: lettuce, ranch or blue cheese, celery, baby carrots, butter for the sauce

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Slice each chicken breast in half the long way.
Season and sear in a little oil over medium-high, 5–6 minutes a side. Rest, then chop.
Toss the hot chicken with Frank's (plus a little melted butter if we have it).
Fill warm tortillas with lettuce, chicken, cheese and ranch. Roll tight.
Toast seam side down in a dry pan until golden, then flip. Save extra chicken for lunch.

key: Sauce the chicken while it's hot so it soaks in. Milder eaters: sauce only half.
done: Chicken is white all the way through (165°F) and the wraps are golden.
plan_b: No tortillas? Buffalo chicken over lettuce with cheese and ranch.
